queries.public_draw: random.Random(122).choice over each upstream category file sorted by query_id, in order b2b, recruiting, influencer, deterministic
queries.intent: 6 queries written for ReacherX's use case (public posts showing a need), reported as a separate track: int_0001-0002 from the first round, int_0003-0006 detailed prompts added after it (int_0005 is a prompt a ReacherX maintainer uses)
queries.intent_short: int_0007-0010: one-line versions of int_0003-0006, graded against their detailed twin's criteria (grade_as) so a vague prompt is judged on what the user really wanted

deviations_from_upstream: top 10 results per query instead of 15 (coverage uses K=10)
Tavily search_depth basic instead of advanced, and at most 2 searches per person, to fit the free Tavily quota
criteria are extracted once per query and judge model and shared by every tool (upstream re-extracts per tool)
final judge is google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (upstream code default is google/gemini-3-flash-preview)

reacherx.input: query text as the setup description; setup draft (ICPs, targeting) generated by ReacherX itself; one prospecting cycle; production models
reacherx.output: qualified prospects only (fit score >= 70, as a user sees them), best fit first, up to top_k
reacherx.cost: OpenRouter key usage delta during the run + provider costs ReacherX records (providerRequestEvents)

apollo.retry: one automatic broadening re-translation when the first query returns 0 people

firecrawl.adapter: one person extracted per web result by the translator model

clay.input: Clay query written by the translator model from Clay's own query reference
clay.retry: one automatic broadening re-translation when the first query returns 0 people

reacherx_topfit.role: SECONDARY view, added after the pilot showed ReacherX's strict qualifier returns 0 people on some queries while other tools return their top 10 unfiltered
reacherx_topfit.definition: same ReacherX run; top_k prospects by fit score including those below the 70 bar
reacherx_topfit.primary_unchanged: reacherx (qualified only) stays the frozen primary

judge_note: free OpenRouter models were rate limited (429) and gemini-2.5-flash-lite returned empty verdicts in the wiring test, so trial and final both use gemini-3.1-flash-lite; empty verdicts are retried twice, then counted as judge errors

extra_metrics.intent_verified: intent track only: a person counts when the judge marked EVERY post-related criterion (posted publicly, on/after the date, about the asked need) as met with web evidence. Upstream relevance averages all criteria equally, so a matching static profile with no post still scores 0.4-0.6.
extra_metrics.counts_per_query: returned, unique (LinkedIn slug or name), criteria_passing (grade >= 0.5), verifiable (most criteria judged with high/medium confidence), undated (tool gave no dated activity; Exa dates are page dates)
extra_metrics.amended: 2026-11-06, after the 6 API tools' pilot verdicts and before any ReacherX intent result

reacherx.inf_0028: not run: asks for Instagram creators; ReacherX searches X and LinkedIn only (out of scope)
reacherx.det_0010: not run: limited borrowed LinkedIn credits were kept for intent queries (Khalid's call after int_0002)

reacherx_topfit.rec_0020: not run: LinkdAPI free credits ran out mid-run (diagnostic kept); re-running needed ~600-950 LinkedIn credits for a database-style recruiting lookup
reacherx_topfit.inf_0028: not run: asks for Instagram creators; ReacherX searches X and LinkedIn only (out of scope)
reacherx_topfit.det_0010: not run: limited borrowed LinkedIn credits were kept for intent queries (Khalid's call after int_0002)

not_run_rule: A not-run query is excluded from that tool's averages (it is not scored as zero). Empty or failed answers from a run that happened still count as zero.
